#!/bin/bash
mkdir -p images/optimized
for f in images/originals/*.{jpg,jpeg,png}; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  name=$(basename "$f")
  base=${name%.*}
  for w in 400 800 1200; do
    convert "$f" -resize ${w}x -strip -quality 85 "images/optimized/${base}-${w}.jpg"
    cwebp -q 80 "images/optimized/${base}-${w}.jpg" -o "images/optimized/${base}-${w}.webp"
  done
done
